messages.text: Your prices are too high compared to competitors. Can I still pick up my order late tonight or maybe on Sunday?

I understand you are concerned about the pricing, but we are closed on Sunday. However, we are delighted to serve you until 8:00 PM on Fridays, so we can absolutely prepare your order then! We are confident that the quality of our items will make you very happy.
You said we are closed Sunday but my competitor is cheaper. Can I pick up late tonight then?

We are committed to providing exceptional quality, and we are open until 8:00 PM tonight to make sure you can pick up your order! Please let us know when you would like to come in, and we will be happy to assist you.
Your prices are still too high. If I can't pick it up late tonight or Sunday, I will go to the cheaper place. Can you confirm a late Sunday pickup?

I am so sorry for the frustration, but we are strictly closed on Sundays, which is our policy. To make things as convenient as possible, would you perhaps consider picking up your order on Friday, when we are open until 8:00 PM? We are confident you will enjoy the quality we offer.
